verdict.rationale: OpenTofu keeps infrastructure definitions in human-readable configuration files that users version and own (opentofu-docs-28, opentofu-gh-2). It is an open-source, drop-in replacement for Terraform (opentofu-docs-1, opentofu-docs-26, opentofu-docs-40), and users report switching is trivial (opentofu-comm-7), which implies low lock-in and an easy exit path. Missing for 10: documentation that state and plan files use an open, exportable format; any explicit export or migrate-out workflow (including decrypting encrypted state before leaving); hands-on evidence of migrating away from OpenTofu.
